doc: The site this page is of, asked from inside the page: what it is, its routes, the sections that answer a question, a page as it was written. The answers are the ones the `oweb` command gives of the site as built and the ones its static files hold (llms.txt, each route's index.md, site.search.xdef.json) — whichever door an agent comes by, a site says the same. Its files are fetched when first asked for, once; a reader who asks nothing pays for none.

tools.name: site.describe
tools.description: What the site is, as it says it at each of its doors: its title, address and languages, each route with its title and its Markdown's address, the requests to go on with — and the text its build wrote as llms.txt

tools.name: routes.list
tools.description: The site's routes: each its address, source, title, language and headings with their anchors

tools.name: page.read
tools.description: One route as it was written: its Markdown (what an agent that only fetches reads) or its HTML

tools.name: docs.search
tools.description: The sections of the site's pages that hold every word asked for, best first: each its route, its anchor, the headings it is under and the line that says so. The words are also put in the page's search box: who reads the page sees what was asked and what was found

query.description: the words; text without spaces between words matches by characters in a row

tasks.name: read-the-site
tasks.summary: What the site is and holds, the sections that answer a question, then a page as Markdown
